new_defects.title: Delta 2(b) is worded as an undefined field, but head also throws on undefined/NaN outside object fields (array elements, top-level values) at the action-lifecycle and snapshot sites
new_defects.evidence: Measured in qa-s2a/evidence-review.txt section (1): [undefined] -> base action-lifecycle [] vs head THROWS; [NaN] -> base [null] vs head THROWS; bare undefined/NaN -> base undefined/null vs head THROWS; equal([undefined], []) -> base true vs head THROWS. Reachability was checked and the class cannot occur: beginAction runs requireValidBundle -> bundle validation -> validateReport before the only canonical() call, every equal() argument is JSON-derived or a struct with no optional fields, and snapshot's inputs come from zod schemas with no optional key among the two compared values (zod 4.6.7 also rejects NaN). No substantiated behaviour change outside the declared deltas. Owed to the next bounded slice: one line in charter/DONE/mg-s2a-codecs.md widening delta 2(b)'s wording. Not blocking.
